goals.title: Pawn AI v2 (needs-driven utility)
goals.objective: system_ai scores jobs by need urgency, distance, and skill; sleep when rest<25; eat when food<30; idle wardens pick by score not just nearest. Adds traits influence

goals.title: Wild critter entities + wander AI
goals.objective: Spawn wild critter packs per biome; Wild component with home range + aggression; system_wild_ai handles wander, idle, aggro-on-proximity

goals.title: Capture & tame mechanic
goals.objective: Capture-disc item + tame action on weakened wild critter; success roll uses skills.tame and species charm; tamed critter flips Faction to Player and joins party

goals.title: Critter work assignment + execution
goals.objective: Critters with workTag join job board; species-specific bonuses (ferroquill mining, tindercub cook, brackboar haul-heavy); per-critter assign UI

goals.title: Raid event → battle scene trigger
goals.objective: Raid scheduler (15-25 game days, wealth-scaled); on landing transition screen=battle with player active critters vs raider team

goals.title: BattleScreen UI wired to BattleSim
goals.objective: Party row, move wheel (4 moves + switch + item), target picker, action log, keyboard nav; deterministic via shared rng; victory/defeat returns to colony

goals.title: Day/night cycle visuals + nocturnal
goals.objective: Tinted overlay by phaseOf(sim); nocturnal species get +spd at night; sun/moon icon in HUD; tests verify phase boundaries

goals.title: Tilemap chunking + perf hardening
goals.objective: 16x16 chunks with dirty-rect repaint; PathClient reuses one ArrayBuffer; in-DEV perf overlay (ms/system, fps); 60 FPS at 300 entities target

goals.title: Codex sprite generation + atlas
goals.objective: Run tools/codex-gen/run-critters.ts; promote accepted SVGs to src/assets/sprites/critter; tools/asset-pack.ts builds atlas; EntityLayer renders from atlas

goals.title: Save v2 + final quality gate
goals.objective: Schema v2 preserves eids + Bond + Critter + battle outcome flags; migration v1->v2; golden-load fixture test; ai-slop-cleaner + verification + code-review all clean
